title: Middle open facing a 3-bet from behind
keyIdea: Your LJ/HJ open is wider, so their 3-bet range is a bit wider too. 4-bet the best hands and continue with strong pairs and broadways.

actions.call: JJ-77, AQs-ATs, KQs-KJs, QJs, JTs, AQo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
